environment.prep_transport: Authenticated candidate loopback HTTP through encrypted SSH from Windows; public ingress not exercised
environment.database_transport: PostgreSQL on VPS through encrypted SSH tunnel from Windows

measurement.clock: One Windows monotonic clock; consumer event is an upper bound after a coherent committed SQLite read
measurement.processing_interval: Matching raw transaction received from Prep to matching committed consumer projection
measurement.broadcast_interval: Broadcast request to matching Prep response; includes mining, configured source confirmation, ingestion and polling; not pure block-production latency
measurement.confirmation_policy: Source follower uses one confirmation; no additional settlement confirmation delay measured

setup_attempts.result: Stopped before funding to tighten bootstrap readiness gate
Stopped before readiness: operator omitted local wallet/scanner path environment variables

limitations: Six live samples; nearest-rank p95 is the maximum, not a population tail estimate or SLA.
Owned self-transfers; no external sender attribution or financial settlement.
No natural reorg occurred in the live sample; recovery uses separate synthetic branches.
Internal change values, viewing/spending keys and credentials are excluded.
Scanner and child aggregate resource peaks were not measured.
Previous interrupted and catch-up runs remain separate historical evidence.
